notes.title: V0.95.7 Frame Time Optomizations
notes.content:
- Shrank the visibility bubble for name and rank by half, and turned the update time to 0.5 seconds.
 this reduced frame time from 1.9 milliseconds to 0.350 milliseconds

 - Removed Dynamic lighting from the sky and weather system 
 This reduced the frame time from 0.200 milliseconds to 0.050 milliseconds

 - Removed collisions and overlap events from the player knife, syringe and arms
 This reduced Frame time from 1.350 milliseconds to 0.320 milliseconds

 - Removed Most of the Real Time Dynamic lighting from the levels
This on average reduced render Frame time by 1.2 milliseconds

 - Removed Animation Blueprints from wall weapons skeletal meshes, the blueprint was being referenced in runtime for no reason. This saved 0.050 milliseconds in frame timing

 - Changed the fountains on last resort to a less render time taxing fountain.

- Removed unnecessary tick from multiple blueprints dragging down the game thread at runtime.

- Removed the collision of Blood droplets on the zombie hit effect. 
the 25 droplets were checking if they hit the ground every single Shot every. 001 Seconds. This saved frame time by nearly 2.8 milliseconds

Roughly 6.98 milliseconds of frame time has been restored. 

The lower the milliseconds the faster the frames.
 
The FX of the Hell Creatures will be optimized in the next update.

notes.title: Development and future update QC
notes.content:
Ok... wow, WHAT A JOURNEY!

This has been alot of work but I won't lie it has been fun! This project has gone so much further than I could have ever imagined. There have been ups and downs - from "Can I even achieve this vision?" to major moments of excitement when things come together.

All that being said... Does the game have some issues? Yes, absolutely. I'm not going to pretend there aren't things that need some work. I, as a developer, have a duty to better quality check my product before updates and expansions. I pledge to dedicate more time to ensure quality over quantity for updates. Updates might take a little bit more time but that definitely beats broken and buggy gameplay.

It's true that I created this game around the weapons, features, mechanics that I like but that does NOT mean the community has no say in what can be put in the game or changed in terms of gameplay mechanics.

Please visit the Discord or post here what you would like to see in future updates, such as weapons, features, locations, modes, or bugs. I value all feedback and I take all player feedback very seriously.

First things first! As soon as the game gets a green flag review (FROM STEAM) I will make the game live. Its my fault, I waited an extra day to send it in for review, I wanted to make sure it was ready. Sorry if there ends up being a slight delay on release. - Working on the spawn in glitch where players attachments are off the weapon. (this Has to do with clients spawning in AFTER the host has spawned) there is a minor latency issue with loading in with a certain players based on the hosts hardware. Simply put host will never have this issue, the Faster SSd hardrive you have (or if you open a single player level before multiplayer) The less this will happen. Obviously I'm working on a fix... it just comes down to loading all the data for every player BEFORE the level is able to begin. This is easier said than done. This can be fixed by pressing V then V again.

notes.title: HotFix.23++
notes.content:
HotFix v.23++

Added electricution animation to zombies for the electric trap. Here's how the trap works. The trap does set amount of damage. It does not tick. So if a the trap does example 100 damage and zombie health is 90 the zombie will immediatly die with No shock animation. If the zombies health is 110 it will take his health to 10 play the animation and stick him there for the duration of the trap. when the trap is over the zombies movement will resume.

Reduced player jump from 550 vertical to 500 vertical.
